correctness.rationale: The order-five ASM state space is exhaustively generated by alternating ±1 row patterns with each column prefix sum in {0,1}, giving exactly 429 labelled matrices. All cylinders on k sites have pairwise Gram contribution binomial(m(A,B),k) for m agreeing cells, so degree≤d Gram is G_d(A,B)=sum_{k<=d}binomial(m,k), and real rank equals marginal-identifiability rank. Independent reconstruction built all 429 states and dense integer G3,G4; modular elimination gave ranks 425 and 429 over both F_101 and F_1009. Independently computed a four-vector null basis anchored at indices [279,321,344,428] with coefficients only -1,0,1 and supports [16,16,134,120], verified exact integer G3@vectors=0 and independent anchors. Thus real G3 rank≥425 by nonzero modular minor and ≤425 by the four exact kernel vectors; G4 full rank via nonzero modular determinant. Signed vectors sum zero, yielding pairs of probability laws with matching ≤3-cell marginals; no sampling or floating-point rank is used.
